svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: An animated loop in two acts. First credential-broker: in a terminal, claude runs broker exec --request for CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, broker's request window springs up asking for a YubiKey touch, the touch grants it for an hour, and the deploy runs with the token shown as [REDACTED:CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN]. Then Signal Box: the lamp in waybar counts grants as they arrive, a click opens the panel out of that icon with three live grants and their time left, a look at a missed ask on the Asks tab, then Revoke all drops every grant, the lamp goes gray, and the panel folds back into the lamp.
svg.title: credential-broker and Signal Box
